pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral expressions.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Oral expressions.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral expressions.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral expressions.

2. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Good day / hello
   C. Thank you
   D. Good night

3. When practising Guided reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided reading.

4. When practising Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Interactive speaking.

5. When practising Selective Listening, Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Selective Listening, Imitative speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Selective Listening, Imitative speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Selective Listening, Imitative speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Selective Listening, Imitative speaking.

6. When practising Phonological awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness.

7. When practising Listening for gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for gist.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for gist.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for gist.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist.

8. When practising Guided Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading.

9. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Buch
   B. Haus
   C. Schule
   D. Wasser

10. When practising Reading aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading aloud.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading aloud.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading aloud.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Selective Listening, Imitative speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Phonological awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Oral expressions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Guided reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Reading aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Reading aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
